create.name: Charlie Morley
create.bio:
Charlie Morley is a London-based teacher of lucid dreaming, dream yoga and shadow work who took up Buddhism at nineteen and spent seven years living at Kagyu Samye Dzong, the Tibetan Buddhist centre in London. He trained under the mindfulness pioneer Rob Nairn, with whom he developed the approach he calls Mindfulness of Dream and Sleep, and in 2008 Lama Yeshe Rinpoche of Samye Ling gave him permission to teach within the Kagyu tradition. Before that he worked as an actor and scriptwriter and fronted a hip hop collective.

His teaching treats the hours we spend asleep as time for practice: learning to recognise a dream from inside it, then using that awareness to meet the hidden sides of the personality and to explore the Tibetan night-time practices of milam. He has written several books for Hay House, among them Dreams of Awakening, Lucid Dreaming Made Easy and Do the Shadow Work, and he teaches through recorded courses, weekend workshops in London and online, and residential retreats in Britain, Europe and further afield. He also runs a long training for therapists, coaches and meditation teachers who want to guide others in lucid dreaming, and has worked with sleep scientists on several research studies.

books.title: Dreams of Awakening (Revised Edition)
books.author: Charlie Morley
books.description: His fullest guide to lucid dreaming as a path of psychological and spiritual growth, drawing on Western dream research and Tibetan Buddhist dream yoga. This revised edition adds new material and new day and night practices.

books.title: Lucid Dreaming Made Easy
books.author: Charlie Morley
books.description: A short beginner's guide to becoming aware within dreams, with practical steps for recall and lucidity. It first appeared as a title in Hay House's Basics series.

books.title: Do the Shadow Work
books.author: Charlie Morley
books.description: A hands-on workbook for meeting and integrating the parts of ourselves we keep hidden. It uses meditation, self-inquiry, mask work, writing and dream work as its tools.

courses.title: 7 Week Lucid Dreaming Course
courses.description: A recorded video course with lifetime access that teaches lucid dreaming alongside the Mindfulness of Dream and Sleep approach he built with Rob Nairn. It places the practice in both Western and Tibetan Buddhist settings.

courses.title: 7 Week Embracing The Shadow Course
courses.description: A self-paced video course on shadow integration that combines Tibetan Buddhist methods with mindfulness and Western psychology. It runs over seven weekly sessions.

courses.title: Lucid Dreaming Online Summit
courses.description: A recorded collection of talks from twenty-one teachers and researchers on lucid dreaming, dream yoga, yoga nidra and dream science, hosted by Charlie.

courses.title: 100 Hour Lucid Dream Facilitator Training 2027
courses.description: A four-month professional training for therapists, coaches, educators and meditation teachers who want to teach lucid dreaming. It mixes online days, a residential retreat at Karuna Dartmoor and monthly masterclasses, with places limited to twenty-five.

courses.title: Lucid Dreaming Immersive Retreat
courses.description: A four-day lucid dreaming retreat at the Sivananda yoga ashram near Nassau in the Bahamas. Tuition is listed separately from the ashram's accommodation.

courses.title: Dreams of Awakening Retreat: Lucid Dreaming on the Spiritual Path
courses.description: A residential retreat at the Dechen Chöling meditation centre in France for people who already follow a spiritual practice. The programme fee excludes board and lodging.

courses.title: Lucid Dreaming - Into The Shadow
courses.description: A residential retreat on Dartmoor that pairs lucid dreaming with shadow work, taught by Charlie with an assistant.

free_resources.title: Free Introduction to Lucid Dreaming and Mindfulness of Dream and Sleep
free_resources.description: A free short video course by Charlie covering what lucid dreaming is, dream recall and dream signs.
